The Great Chain Robbery

By: Harri Vithi | Commission

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

Unique Selling Point:
This story is about the curious case of missing mayoral chains across several provinces. Most South African municipalities aren't covered in glory as far as municipal management. So, it's no surprise that any valuables, including mayoral chains worth millions of Rands could go missing. Quietly stolen by a greedy official, perhaps even in broad daylight.


Summary:
This story will be told with a mix of appropriate humour and seriousness. It is after all corruption and an example of the many ways greed seeps into municipal corridors.


Further information:
The insert’s main focus will be on Sedibeng District Mayor - Cllr Lerato Maloka - as we have the strongest trail of evidence pointing guilty fingers in her direction, including:-
Reports and supporting videos found here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1VKYA6EdRuWMZAA_hUOKwos2m_RkUPjQwK18O0Hh5xDc/edit?usp=sharing
A damning report on the missing mayoral chain indicating the mayor deliberately changed security protocols in place. Within 5 months the 18 carat gold chain was missing - report attached
Exclusive information from our security source detailing the security in place in and around the mayor’s office which would have made it difficult to facilitate a break-in. See attached video evidence (not for publication to protect our source)
Sources allege the mayoral chain was sold at a Cash Crusaders in Three Rivers
Supporting Evidence
Brown sugar in an unwanted Mercedes GLB 250 kept hidden at the Vaal Teknorama Museum - see attached video evidence of hidden Mercedes and vehicle assessment reports
Allegations of wasteful expenditure blowing R 500 000 in HIV/AIDS grant money unnecessarily extending a trip to Germany for an HIV/AIDS conference
Making the municipality a mom and pop shop by employing her two stepsons. One accused of R 5.5 million licensing department fraud
Accused of being a crack-junkie mayor who frequents Hillbrow until the wee hours of the morning with her state issued protectors. There are alleged images of Cllr Maloka slumped beside a toilet seat with a white substance on her nose. Still trying to convince a source to share the images.
Previously ousted this year but reinstated despite her trail of alleged misgivings

Mayoral chain
Venues - TBC
2x Actors
Security x1 day

Script:


The Great Chain Robbery

(Dr Mpho Phalatse) The chain is an emblem of first citizenship.

(Kingsol Chabalala)(Subtitles) In essence, it represents the aspirations, the hopes, the dreams of our people.

(Tshidi Madia) Mayoral chains! I never think about mayoral chains.
(Tshidi Madia)I don't think you need to be draped in gold to symbolise the importance of your office
(Tshidi Madia) It's optics and I'm not sure for who to be honest

(Masa Kekana) The symbols in question are the country’s mayoral chains, in some cases, reportedly worth millions of Rands.

(Masa Kekana) That might explain why some appear to have vanished into thin air. So, are they gathering dust in the wardrobes of departed public officials or is something more sinister at play? We’re here to investigate the mystery.

(Masa Kekana) A mayoral inauguration is a big deal. It’s an opportunity to re-hash promises about renewal and pledging to work in the best interests of the citizens. At its centre: the shiny chain draped around the mayor’s shoulders.

(Dr Mpho Phalatse) I believe it gives dignity to the office. I believe it signifies the weight of the responsibility.

(Masa Kekana) Former Joburg mayor Dr Mpho Phalatse lasted just over a year in the city’s volatile political climate. She believes the chain is more than an accessory.

(Dr Mpho Phalatse) I never got to see it. Never got to touch it, never got to wear it. I had been asking, where's the chain? And nobody could answer where the chain was.

(Dr Mpho Phalatse) …but you know, there was so much we were dealing with it paled in comparison to other priorities.

(Masa Kekana) Eventually, she was told where the chain was being held.

(Dr Mpho Phalatse) I did see pictures of several chains that belonged to the city of Johannesburg that are sitting in the vault of a particular bank.

(Masa Kekana)Protocol normally demands that the chain be kept in a vault with limited access, with the mayor effectively “borrowing” it for special occasions.

(Masa Kekana) But, perhaps unsurprisingly, that’s not how it works in some parts of the country.

(Masa Kekana) The mayoral chain has gone missing in several municipalities.

(Masa Kekana) Well, that’s the case in at least three municipalities we know of. And the explanations offered are varied.

(Subtitles)(Reenactment) The police are investigating.
(Subtitles)(Reenactment) No comment
(Subtitles)(Reenactment) Ask the head of security.

(Masa Kekana) Matjhabeng, Nelson Mandela Bay and the Sedibeng District Municipality are plagued by allegations of mismanagement and corruption – environments ripe for the disappearance of valuable assets.
And of the three, Sedibeng stands out as the most intriguing.

(Masa Kekana) And Mayor Lerato Maloka will be a key focus of our investigation.

(Masa Kekana) The mayoral chain Maloka is wearing in this portrait is the subject of a leaked internal security report. It’s reportedly worth around half a million rand and around two years ago, it went missing.

(Masa Kekana) Maloka has been mayor of Gauteng’s Sedibeng District Municipality for four years.

(Tshidi Madia) Every election year, I know we must send somebody in the Sedibeng area, because I know that the stories will be problematic, they will be harrowing. It will speak of governance failures.

(Masa Kekana) Tshidi Madia is the Political Editor at news platform, EWN.

(Masa Kekana) After a motion of no confidence removed her earlier this year, Maloka was almost immediately reinstated.

(Tshidi Madia) There's enough clouds over her head for people to question her integrity and whether or not she should be in that office.

(Masa Kekana) Could she be the one who nicked the Sedibeng mayoral chain?
Well let’s look at our options

(Masa Kekana) Door number 1: It was a professional job

(Masa Kekana) Is it possible the chain was stolen from the Sedibeng municipality’s office by career criminals?


(Masa Kekana) The DA’s Kingsol Chabalala isn’t buying the “professional job” theory.

(Kingsol Chabalala)(Subtitles) For you to access the mayor's Office there's a trellidor door there so it has never been broken...

(Masa Kekana) And then there’s the fingerprint access…

(Kingsol Chabalala)(Subtitles) Remember you only store a few fingerprints of people who are able to access the office.

(Masa Kekana) He says no burglary was reported to the police.

(Masa Kekana) Given the security in place at the mayor’s office, this scenario is highly unlikely.

(Masa Kekana) So, with one scenario apparently ruled out, what lessons might be learned from the other missing chain cases we know of?

(Masa Kekana) Former Matjhabeng mayor - Nkosinjani Speelman - this mayoral chain reportedly worth many millions of Rands went missing during his controversial tenure. The Hawks never traced the chain and the case is officially closed. But the municipality refuses to answer our questions.

(Masa Kekana) And former mayor, Speelman says we should ask the municipality.

(Masa Kekana)So if Matjhabeng is anything to go by, there’s a real risk of the trail going cold in Sedibeng.

(Masa Kekana) That chain was last seen in June 2023 - when Maloka wore it to the State of the District address.

(Kingsol Chabalala)(Subtitles) When the mayoral chain was supposed to be taken to the vault,
the mayor flatly refused to hand over the mayoral chain and say she'll keep it in her office. And then after some time, when the mayor was supposed to give back the mayoral chain, she indicated that the mayoral chain is missing.

(Masa Kekana)According to the leaked report, Maloka violated protocol by keeping the chain on a bookshelf in her office, when it should have been handed to a unit called Protection Services.

(Tshidi Madia) A mayor wanting to keep a mayoral chain in her office is truly bizarre.
(Tshidi Madia) It also leaves me quite suspicious that there might be nefarious reasons why.
(Tshidi Madia) What sort of a leader undermines the rules for safekeeping?

(Dr Mpho Phalatse) It's reckless. It's irresponsible. I would never do that.

(Masa Kekana) Maloka’s protocol breach appears to have left the chain at the mercy of those with access to her office. Which brings us to our next scenario.

(Masa Kekana) Door number 2, it was an inside job.

(Kingsol Chabalala)(Subtitles) There are only two people who have keys to that door - the mayor and the PA.

(Masa Kekana)Does that narrow down the potential suspects? Or is it possible the office door was left unlocked? The ideal moment for an opportunistic official to swoop. An official who knew where to look, what to look for… and where to find it.
(Masa Kekana) What pointers might there be in Nelson Mandela Bay, where it’s been reported that three gold mayoral chains with an estimated value of three million Rand went missing two years ago?

(Masa Kekana)The Metro didn’t respond to our repeated requests for comment. But Deputy Mayor Gary van Niekerk told us only one chain went missing. He says after months of searching and threats of prosecution, the clerk responsible for its safekeeping revealed that it was at a jeweller’s for repairs.

(Dr Mpho Phalatse) …in a country where corruption is the order of the day, it's really a question of what are you going to steal? You know, is it the next contract? Is it a mayoral chain? Is it a vehicle?

(Masa Kekana) It’s interesting Phalatse mentions vehicles, because years before the Mayoral Chain debacle, Sedibeng and its mayor were caught up in another controversy involving a Mercedes and a bag of sugar.

(Masa Kekana)The car was purchased four years ago, but according to the report, Maloka simply refused to use it.

(Masa Kekana) As mayor, what do you do when you don’t like your state-issued Mercedes Benz? Well, you demand the colour be changed from that drab white to black
(Kingsol Chabalala)(Subtitles) The municipality they spent, nice car, nice car about R 200k.
(Masa Kekana) Nice car
Kingsol Chabalala)(Subtitles) Nice car. This is the car which the mayor says she's not comfortable in it. It's hurting her knees. She wants a bigger, more expensive car. I think the mayor she needs to only be more concerned about the comfort of her residents.

(Masa Kekana) Then you have it changed back to white, of course.
Still not good enough? Park it in a basement until council forces you to use it…

(Kingsol Chabalala)(subtitles) The night before, the car was parked at the mayor's residence so in the morning when the protectors and the driver came to perform their duties.. They drove a distance of less than 500 meters and the engine seized. They took it to Mercedes... And they said sugary substance in the oil system.

(Masa Kekana)And the day before it was fine?

(Masa Kekana) It was driving nice.

(Masa Kekana) Someone had poured brown sugar into the engine with, according to the report, “deliberate consequence”. It would have cost almost R400 000 to repair the damage.
(Masa Kekana)So, the Mercedes remains in storage behind this door, while the municipality spends hundreds of thousands on rentals.

(Tshidi Madia) It must make everybody question how every rand and every cent is utilized by that particular leader.

(Masa Kekana) So, with the sugary Mercedes incident unresolved, we return to the final scenario, another unsettled mystery – the vanishing mayoral chain.

(Masa Kekana) Door number three: It was the mayor.

(Masa Kekana) Kingsol has certainly reached his own conclusions.

(Kingsol Chabalala) (Subtitles)The mayor knows what happened to that, uh, to that mayoral chain I think her intentions were very clear.

(Masa Kekana) Stored on a shelf in her office, the chain was forever within the mayor’s grasp.

(Masa Kekana) And this chain is pretty small... It can fit in my handbag

(Masa Kekana)The leaked security report found Maloka was the last person who saw the chain.

(Masa Kekana)I’m on my way to the Sedibeng City Hall to ask the mayor what happened to the mayoral chain…

(Masa Kekana) We waited for the mayor to exit her rented Mercedes but instead she stays put and summons her staff to act as her mouthpiece…
(Masa Kekana) We wanted to ask about the missing mayoral chain

(Municipal Official)(Subtitles) The The response is that the police are investigating, we even laid a charge

(Masa Kekana) Isnt it the mayor changed the security protocol, we want to understand why she changed it

(Municipal Official)(Subtitles)What protocol what security…?

(Masa Kekana) Eventually, the mayor promises to speak to us after her meeting.

(Masa Kekana) Mayor, we really would like to ask you about the missing mayoral chain?

(Mayor Lerato Maloka)(Subtitles)What about the missing mayoral chain

(Masa Kekana) You say it was a robbery but there was no forced entry
(Mayor Lerato Maloka)(subtitles) The head of security submitted a report and as I informed you the matters with the SAPS

(Masa Kekana) Why did you change security protocols?

Mayor Lerato Maloka)(Subtitles) What protocols? What security protocols?

(Masa Kekana) That’s fine, I’m asking you why the chain was in your office? Did you put sugar in your car by the way because there is a report about the sugar in your car..because the Mercedes Benz GLE apparently wasn't good enough mayor. Are you not going to answer any of these questions?You don't think that people would like to know what happened to the missing mayoral chain? Suddenly a mayoral chain goes missing! When it was in your…

(Mayor Lerato Maloka) Ma’am I told you the matter is with the SAPS it’s being investigated let that process run and then we’ll take it from there

(Masa Kekana) I want to know why it was in your office in the first place? Why did it move to your office? That is bizarre don't you think? It’s an unsafe space to keep something so valuable. So you’re not going to answer any of these questions, you're just going to walk off mayor

(Mayor Lerato Maloka)(Subtitles) Ask the head of security, he can respond to you

(Masa Kekana) Who keeps a mayoral chain in their office?

(Masa Kekana) Looks like the mayor doesn't want to answer very simple simple questions - where the mayoral chain is. Especially about your car, what happened to the sugar substance that was found in your car mayor …and there we have it, the mayor has nothing to say but there’s an investigation about a so-called robbery where there was no forced entry

(Masa Kekana) A day later, the mayor sent an email stating: "there is an independent investigation and a report will be tabled this month.”

(Masa Kekana) Now, I’m not a betting woman but who’s your money on - was it the mayor, was it her PA or maybe a conniving municipal official who hacked the security system?

(Masa Kekana) Do you think it can ever be recovered? Any of them?

(Dr Mpho Phalatse) Probably not. It's probably been sold and processed or shipped off. I wouldn't hold my breath.

(Masa Kekana) As mayor, what do you do when you don’t like your state-issued Mercedes Benz? Well, you demand the colour be changed from that drab white to black (Kingsol Chabalala)(Subtitles) The municipality they spent, nice car, nice car about R 200k. (Masa Kekana) Nice car Kingsol Chabalala)(Subtitles) Nice car. This is the car which the mayor says she's not comfortable in it. It's hurting her knees. She wants a bigger, more expensive car. I think the mayor she needs to only be more concerned about the comfort of her residents. (Masa Kekana) Then you have it changed back to white, of course. Still not good enough? Park it in a basement until council forces you to use it… (Kingsol Chabalala)(subtitles) The night before, the car was parked at the mayor's residence so in the morning when the protectors and the driver came to perform their duties.. They drove a distance of less than 500 meters and the engine seized. They took it to Mercedes... And they said sugary substance in the oil system. (Masa Kekana)And the day before it was fine? (Masa Kekana) It was driving nice. (Masa Kekana) Someone had poured brown sugar into the engine with, according to the report, “deliberate consequence”. It would have cost almost R400 000 to repair the damage. (Masa Kekana)So, the Mercedes remains in storage behind this door, while the municipality spends hundreds of thousands on rentals. (Tshidi Madia) It must make everybody question how every rand and every cent is utilized by that particular leader. (Masa Kekana) So, with the sugary Mercedes incident unresolved, we return to the final scenario, another unsettled mystery – the vanishing mayoral chain. (Masa Kekana) Door number three: It was the mayor. (Masa Kekana) Kingsol has certainly reached his own conclusions. (Kingsol Chabalala) (Subtitles)The mayor knows what happened to that, uh, to that mayoral chain I think her intentions were very clear. (Masa Kekana) Stored on a shelf in her office, the chain was forever within the mayor’s grasp. (Masa Kekana) And this chain is pretty small... It can fit in my handbag (Masa Kekana)The leaked security report found Maloka was the last person who saw the chain. (Masa Kekana)I’m on my way to the Sedibeng City Hall to ask the mayor what happened to the mayoral chain… (Masa Kekana) We waited for the mayor to exit her rented Mercedes but instead she stays put and summons her staff to act as her mouthpiece… (Masa Kekana) We wanted to ask about the missing mayoral chain (Municipal Official)(Subtitles) The The response is that the police are investigating, we even laid a charge (Masa Kekana) Isnt it the mayor changed the security protocol, we want to understand why she changed it (Municipal Official)(Subtitles)What protocol what security…? (Masa Kekana) Eventually, the mayor promises to speak to us after her meeting. (Masa Kekana) Mayor, we really would like to ask you about the missing mayoral chain? (Mayor Lerato Maloka)(Subtitles)What about the missing mayoral chain (Masa Kekana) You say it was a robbery but there was no forced entry (Mayor Lerato Maloka)(subtitles) The head of security submitted a report and as I informed you the matters with the SAPS (Masa Kekana) Why did you change security protocols? Mayor Lerato Maloka)(Subtitles) What protocols? What security protocols? (Masa Kekana) That’s fine, I’m asking you why the chain was in your office? Did you put sugar in your car by the way because there is a report about the sugar in your car..because the Mercedes Benz GLE apparently wasn't good enough mayor. Are you not going to answer any of these questions?You don't think that people would like to know what happened to the missing mayoral chain? Suddenly a mayoral chain goes missing! When it was in your… (Mayor Lerato Maloka) Ma’am I told you the matter is with the SAPS it’s being investigated let that process run and then we’ll take it from there (Masa Kekana) I want to know why it was in your office in the first place? Why did it move to your office? That is bizarre don't you think? It’s an unsafe space to keep something so valuable. So you’re not going to answer any of these questions, you're just going to walk off mayor (Mayor Lerato Maloka)(Subtitles) Ask the head of security, he can respond to you (Masa Kekana) Who keeps a mayoral chain in their office? (Masa Kekana) Looks like the mayor doesn't want to answer very simple simple questions - where the mayoral chain is. Especially about your car, what happened to the sugar substance that was found in your car mayor …and there we have it, the mayor has nothing to say but there’s an investigation about a so-called robbery where there was no forced entry (Masa Kekana) A day later, the mayor sent an email stating: "there is an independent investigation and a report will be tabled this month.” (Masa Kekana) Now, I’m not a betting woman but who’s your money on - was it the mayor, was it her PA or maybe a conniving municipal official who hacked the security system? (Masa Kekana) Do you think it can ever be recovered? Any of them? (Dr Mpho Phalatse) Probably not. It's probably been sold and processed or shipped off. I wouldn't hold my breath.

metadata.Unique Selling Point: This story is about the curious case of missing mayoral chains across several provinces. Most South African municipalities aren't covered in glory as far as municipal management. So, it's no surprise that any valuables, including mayoral chains worth millions of Rands could go missing. Quietly stolen by a greedy official, perhaps even in broad daylight.
metadata.Summary: This story will be told with a mix of appropriate humour and seriousness. It is after all corruption and an example of the many ways greed seeps into municipal corridors.
metadata.Further information: The insert’s main focus will be on Sedibeng District Mayor - Cllr Lerato Maloka - as we have the strongest trail of evidence pointing guilty fingers in her direction, including:- Reports and supporting videos found here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1VKYA6EdRuWMZAA_hUOKwos2m_RkUPjQwK18O0Hh5xDc/edit?usp=sharing A damning report on the missing mayoral chain indicating the mayor deliberately changed security protocols in place. Within 5 months the 18 carat gold chain was missing - report attached Exclusive information from our security source detailing the security in place in and around the mayor’s office which would have made it difficult to facilitate a break-in. See attached video evidence (not for publication to protect our source) Sources allege the mayoral chain was sold at a Cash Crusaders in Three Rivers Supporting Evidence Brown sugar in an unwanted Mercedes GLB 250 kept hidden at the Vaal Teknorama Museum - see attached video evidence of hidden Mercedes and vehicle assessment reports Allegations of wasteful expenditure blowing R 500 000 in HIV/AIDS grant money unnecessarily extending a trip to Germany for an HIV/AIDS conference Making the municipality a mom and pop shop by employing her two stepsons. One accused of R 5.5 million licensing department fraud Accused of being a crack-junkie mayor who frequents Hillbrow until the wee hours of the morning with her state issued protectors. There are alleged images of Cllr Maloka slumped beside a toilet seat with a white substance on her nose. Still trying to convince a source to share the images. Previously ousted this year but reinstated despite her trail of alleged misgivings
